    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BankAccount_To_PaymentMerge" sourceRef="Task_EnterIBANAndBIC" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaymentMerge_To_SubscriptionMerge" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentMerge" targetRef="Gateway_SubscriptionMerge"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BrainstormNames_To_CharacterSetupJoin" sourceRef="Task_BrainstormNames" targetRef="Gateway_CharacterSetupJoin"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckAvailability_To_NameGateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckNameAvailability" targetRef="Gateway_NameAvailable"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NameAvailable" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_NameAvailable" targetRef="Gateway_ConfirmationAndSelfiesSplit">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">nameAvailable</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NameUnavailable" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_NameAvailable" targetRef="Task_EnterCharacterName">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not nameAvailable</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ConfirmationSplit_To_Confirmation" sourceRef="Gateway_ConfirmationAndSelfiesSplit" targetRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ConfirmationSplit_To_Selfies" sourceRef="Gateway_ConfirmationAndSelfiesSplit" targetRef="Task_ReceiveCharacterSelfies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Confirmation_To_OutputsJoin" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" targetRef="Gateway_ConfirmationAndSelfiesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Selfies_To_OutputsJoin" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveCharacterSelfies" targetRef="Gateway_ConfirmationAndSelfiesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OutputsJoin_To_ExpansionMessage" sourceRef="Gateway_ConfirmationAndSelfiesJoin" targetRef="Event_ExpansionReleaseMessage"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ExpansionMessage_To_End" sourceRef="Event_ExpansionReleaseMessage" targetRef="End_CharacterGenerator"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description states that a distinct activity is performed while other activities are in progress and that a later activity depends on their completion: Model the distinct activity and the other required work on concurrent branches, then synchronize those branches before the dependent activity.
rules.situation: the description states that separate activities can proceed while another required sequence is underway, and a later activity depends on the work from both tracks being complete

rules.instruction: When the description states an activity or outcome whose surrounding context is already clear from the process flow: Use a concise BPMN label that preserves the activity or outcome, without adding explanatory context that does not distinguish it from other elements.
rules.situation: the description states an activity, decision, or outcome with a particular action, object, or meaningful qualifier

rules.instruction: When the description identifies a decision, conditional action, or stopping outcome between activities: Model every stated transition with sequence flows, including flows into and out of gateways, and connect each outcome to its next step or end.
rules.situation: the description states transitions into or out of a decision, synchronization point, or repeated activity

rules.instruction: When the description distinguishes activities or outcomes by their action, object, recipient, or stage: Use BPMN labels that preserve those stated distinctions rather than substituting a different action or outcome.
rules.situation: the description explicitly states an activity’s action or an outcome’s distinguishing details

rules.instruction: When the description says that an item or value is tried repeatedly until it meets an acceptance condition: Model the repeated attempt with a decision gateway: exit when the condition is met and loop back for another attempt otherwise.
rules.situation: the description says that an item or value is tried repeatedly until it meets an acceptance condition
